title: A Generalized Weak Galerkin Method for Linear Elasticity with Nonpolynomial Approximations
summary: This paper presents a generalized weak Galerkin (gWG) finite element method for linear elasticity problems on general polygonal and polyhedral meshes. The proposed framework is flexible and efficient, allowing for the use of nonpolynomial approximating functions. The generalized weak differential operators are defined as an element-level correction of the classical differential operators accounting for boundary discontinuities.
